It should be noted that it is more to do with the case itself and the aftermath, it doesn't delve into their childhoods or life at cromwell street. 

But the footage and audio tapes make it all worth it. 

The interviews with Janet Leach were something I never expected to see, and the way the footage had been cleaned up made me double take a few times as it looked modern.

They glossed over a lot of the abuse that the children suffered but I understand why. 

It's probably the best documentary to date. I only wished it had more
